## berth repo publish

put a local folder on GitHub and register it

### Synopsis

put a local folder on GitHub and register it

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_repo_publish/

```
berth repo publish <org> <dir> <owner/repo> [--private|--public|--internal] [flags]
```

### Examples

```

```
